@description:
 Barbarians are non spell users who are uncivilized, outdoor fighters. Their
 combat skills are narrower than other non spell users, but they are very good
 at what they do. They shun armor, but are stronger than any other profession.
 Literary examples of Barbarians would include Conan, Fafhrd, and Cerebus.
